BRETON KAPPA G
Breton Kappa G
Breton Kappa G evolves Breton's polishing platform with a renewed balance between throughput, finish quality and control.
The machine is built to support high repeatability and lower operator friction in demanding plant environments.
Its design language reflects Breton's mature industrial identity: precise, modular and production-focused.
